# P4.22 — exact predicate SPI/tree/compiler: contract and qualification

## Contract for visibility integration

AccessPredicate is pure immutable Kernel data. all/any/not compose booleans; empty all is pass, empty any is deny. eq/in explicitly support NULL; ranges fail on NULL, their NOT complements include NULL. Scalar finite bindings only, plain columns, dotted relations. partition(allow,deny,abstain) asserts exact disjoint/exhaustive adapter outcomes; beforePartition(deny,pass) forbids policy authority. assertPartition checks expected shape, outcome selects a boolean; unsupported in any outcome taints every selection. Constant malformed partitions reject. isSupported propagates unsupported recursively. branch(contribution,predicate) retains one concrete Grant/RoleContribution; assertContribution rejects borrowing another concrete witness even if structurally equal. Arbitrary adapter semantic equivalence must be proved by its scalar/query tests, not inferred by core. Compiler constrain(Builder,AccessPredicate):Builder stages one nested AND group, validates real schema columns and typed native relations, binds all values and never executes resource queries. Same-connection nested/self relations supported; MorphTo/untyped/unknown/cross-connection relations, replaced/aliased host roots and ungrouped host OR explicitly rejected unchanged. VisibilityNotSupportedException translation/integration remains P4.12; engines/CRM/EXPLAIN remain P4.23. Effective native global scopes are materialized once on a clone and frozen on the host only after compilation succeeds. Direct/deferred UNION/UNION ALL queries reject atomically. Every logical expression is itself AND-grouped so ANY inside EXISTS cannot escape the relation key.

## Grammar examples

$policy = AccessPredicate::partition(AccessPredicate::eq('state', 'allow'), AccessPredicate::eq('state', 'deny'), AccessPredicate::not(AccessPredicate::in('state', ['allow', 'deny'])));
$before = AccessPredicate::beforePartition(AccessPredicate::gte('score', 20), AccessPredicate::not(AccessPredicate::gte('score', 20)));
$condition = AccessPredicate::branch($contribution, AccessPredicate::all(AccessPredicate::eq('city', $contribution->fields()['city']), AccessPredicate::exists('project.members', AccessPredicate::eq('active', true))));
$boolean = AccessPredicate::all($before->outcome('pass'), $condition, AccessPredicate::not($policy->outcome('deny')));
$compiler->constrain($query, $boolean);
PolicyOnly uses $policy->outcome('allow') without grant sources. Before-pass never supplies authority. OR combines complete bound branches after each is qualified by the integration engine.
